snippet.title: The Search For The Leviathan
snippet.description:
In the last few months, hundreds of reports have appeared all over the internet, all claiming to see the same thing in their Minecraft oceans - a sea monster called The Leviathan. But is it just a massive hoax, or is there something more to it? I'm going to find out.

Voice of Hummer:  @schpoody 
Voice of Arronax:  @jumperwho 

ORIGINAL MUSIC BY: Ben Bracey (@benbraceymusic on instagram)
https://soundcloud.com/benbraceymusic/sets/hunting-the-leviathan-original

Download all the builds in this video for $5 on both Java and Bedrock!!: https://maps.wifies.net/products/the-leviathan  



DO NOT READ BELOW FOR SPOILERS:


Well well well here we are again. I think this video is interesting in that the first 12 minutes can't prepare you for the remaining hour; as in the pacing is very different/the style totally shifts. So we'll see how that goes...

I'm really fond of the ending I like how that last 10 minutes turned out. That final scene with hummer was inspired by one of my favorite short stories, "Hell is the Absence of God" by Ted Chiang. There are definitely some parts of the video that I think could be a little better like maybe the dialogue is a bit dragged but overall I'm pretty satisfied with the majority of the video. 

Thematically, I think you might be able to tell the kind of story I was playing around with, but I was also hugely inspired by the Lochness Monster. Probably some of my favorite parts of research for this video was reading the Lochness Monster wiki and learning more about the kind of theories/tools people use to look for it. The F3 scene on hummer's boat was inspired by all the sonar and stuff people use to check for Nessie.

Also just a MASSIVE shoutout to schpood for all the hours and care he poured into this video. I'm so thankful for the enthusiasm and feedback he gave and the video would be so much worse without him. And thank you to my discord server members for making (almost) all of the fake reports you see in this video. They were super creative and did a way better job than I could have.

➤➤ Discord: https://discord.gg/zAWUuWb


➤➤Links: 

Want to listen to or license the music I use? Check it out here: https://www.epidemicsound.com/community/playlist/?_us=Affiliate&_usx=1xis5q&utm_source=1xis5q&utm_medium=organicambassador&utm_campaign=1xis5q&playlist=uad3vzakh605efvoqoi24llhnpr9lm2y

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RsVVcsVDt-s
CC BY-SA 4.0

Water Lantern designed by: @MythicalPingu 

Submarine tutorial: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6ud22yz0p7s


All screenshots/reddit posts/websites in this video do NOT exist and were made for the sake of the video. If any link redirects to an actual website - that is coincidental and do not treat it as "official";  it was just put in the video make the world feel more real. 

This is NOT series called Minecraft VVSauce where I explore random features of Minecraft. Not Secret Minecraft things or Minecraft lore (like Game Theory) or Escape Rooms, but an ARG that isn't an ARG but it's actually unfiction - a genre pretending to be real that isn't real but we all pretend to be real. This is the search for the leviathan. I hope you enjoy

snippet.title: Teenage Dirtbag by Wheatus - A Bardcore | Medieval Cover by Hildegard von Blingin' ft. Friar Funk
snippet.description:
▶ This song will be out mid-August, but you can listen to my other work on Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/artist/5BSPl6yCVGvrCyKUp2peGM?si=yyY9lJHsTwq-vf4y2nv9DQ
▶ Consider supporting the channel on Patreon, where I share all my instrumentals: https://patreon.com/hildegardvonblingin

I'm thrilled to welcome my brother Friar Funk back for a feature in this cover of the Wheatus angst anthem "Teenage Dirtbag". We had a lot of fun recording in between bellowing Mordhau and Elder Scrolls lines at each other. Oh, and before anyone gets all clever in the comments, yes the iron maiden (ye old spiked sarcophagus) is mostly a myth, but you'll have to forgive the anachronism because how could I not keep that in?

As always, this music is human made. I wrote the lyrics, created the instrumental from a mix of real and sampled instruments, and we recorded the vocals in my little turret studio.

I'll provide a few notes about the language, because there are some fun words in this one.
Greenhorn: an inexperienced person/newcomer who lacks skill and knowledge.
Wagtail: An obsequious, timid person who fawns and bows like e nervous bird.
Hedgeborn: A person born of low, mean, or unknown birth. Perhaps even on the side of the road somewhere.
Blaggard: A scoundrel, a rogue, or a rascal.

The Art: I illustrated this one from scratch but looked at lots of sad peasants in manuscripts during the process. 

The Lyrics:
Her name is Noelle
I have a dream about her
Under some spell
I’ve Vespers within the hour
How she is fair
With flowers in her hair
But she knoweth not that I live
And she giveth not a fig about me

For I’m but a greenhorn wagtail, lady
Naught but a hedgeborn blaggard, lady
I'd stand in an iron maiden, lady for thee, oh

Her lord is uncouth
He bringeth a sword to Mass
Knew he but the truth
My hide he would surely thrash
His keep's on the hill
'Tis his fields I till
But he knoweth not that I live
And he giveth not a fig about me

For I’m but a greenhorn wagtail, lady
Naught but a hedgeborn blaggard, lady
I'd stand in an iron maiden, lady for thee, oh

Oh, greenhorn!
She knoweth not what she is missing
Oh, hedgeborn!
She knoweth not what she is missing

I feel overbold
This banquet is far too lofty
Lo and behold
She walketh over to me
Must be some ruse, I'll end in the noose
How doth she know that I live?
And why doth she care a whit about me?

I've two palfreys to flee to fair Arcady
Come with me three days hence, I pray thee
I'm naught but a greenhorn wagtail, truly like thee, oh

Oh, greenhorn!
She knoweth not what she is missing
Oh, hedgeborn!
She knoweth not what she is missing
